assumptions: The channel is linear DNA content (area) of singlets; G1 is the tallest peak (or half of it, after a G2/M arrest) and G2/M sits near twice it.
Percentages exclude debris and aggregates, as FlowJo and ModFit report them.
limits: One cycling population per histogram; ModFit-style Multicycle (several overlapping cycles) is not available.
Watson pragmatic gives no standard errors; its S phase is a remainder, not a model.
bio.jane/contract.question: What share of these DNA-stained cells is in G1, S and G2/M?

description: The classical univariate cell-cycle models on a linear DNA-content channel of a project FCS file, optionally one population: Dean–Jett–Fox (Gaussian G1 and G2/M, a broadened second-order polynomial S phase, optional exponential debris and G1+G2 / G2+G2 aggregates, weighted Levenberg–Marquardt) or Watson pragmatic (Gaussians on the outer flank of each peak, S phase as the remainder). % G1, S and G2/M (with delta-method standard errors for Dean–Jett–Fox), peak means and CVs, the G2/G1 ratio, reduced chi-square, the fitted curves and the fit warnings.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

aggregates.description: Dean–Jett–Fox: add G1+G2 and G2+G2 aggregates.

bins.description: histogram bins over 0 to 1.1 × the 99.9th percentile.

cv.description: Dean–Jett–Fox: a fixed G1 CV as a fraction; 0 fits it.

document.description: the FCS file in the project, by name or id.

equal_cv.description: hold the G2 CV at the G1 CV.

flank_correction.description: Watson: model the S-phase edge inside each flank window; false is Watson's original outer-half fit.

gating.description: a Gating-ML or FlowJo .wsp in the project; empty for none.

model.description: the cell-cycle model. Values: djf (Dean–Jett–Fox), watson (Watson pragmatic).

population.description: a population of the strategy to analyze; empty for every event.

ratio.description: a fixed G2/G1 ratio; 0 fits it.

name: fit_flow_cytometry_cell_cycle

curves.description: the histogram and every fitted component per bin, with the bin centres

fit.description: chi-square, reduced chi-square, degrees of freedom, RMSD, fitted bins, parameters, convergence and the warnings

phases.description: % G1, S and G2/M, their standard errors (Dean–Jett–Fox), each peak (mean, CV, SD, area), the S phase, the G2/G1 ratio
